newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee weakens against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee weakens against dollar.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee weakened slightly against the dollar on Tuesday despite central bank intervention on Monday but strengthened against the pound, dealers said.
The rupee was quoted at a mean commercial rate of 20.169 against the dollar from 20.084 on Monday. Against the pound, the rupee traded at a mean of 32.558 on Tuesday from 32.727 on Monday.
Dealers said the central bank sold dollars in the interbank forex market on Monday at four cents lower than the prevailing interbank rate.
But the intervention was not sufficient to prevent weakening the rupee because of dollar strength on international markets.
"Without the intervention, the rupee would have been fixed some 15 cents lower against the dollar today," a dealer said.
